pass_a_gloss:
And indeed our God, who loves us, has a mind insatiable for greed, like horses being restrained, and those who are snared by the nooses of love of glory. The land of the horses is said to be filled, not just one or two having contracted the disease of pride, but as if the whole land is occupied by the passion, and the evil is going through everything. However, He also rebukes those who have stumbled against the law and disobeyed God, who has spoken clearly. If you enter the land that the Lord your God gives you as an inheritance, and you inherit it and live in it, and you say: I will set up a ruler over myself, just like the other nations around me. You shall set up as ruler over yourself one whom the Lord your God chooses. Then He says about the one being set up: because he will not multiply horses for himself, nor will he turn the people back to Egypt, so that he may not multiply horses for himself. And besides this, he will not greatly multiply silver and gold for himself. Therefore, He blames them for making a collection of wealth and multiplying horses for themselves. The reproach, as is likely, touches most of all those who have been allotted to lead, as they transgress the commandment, whom it was necessary to follow and to see that they have been honored before others, and to rebuke those who transgress. And the land was filled with the abominations of the works of their hands, and they worshiped what their fingers had made.

And a man bowed down, and a human was humbled, and he will not lift them up. He again accuses them of the intelligible fornication, and the fact that many chose to worship false gods. He declares that they have reached the limit of impiety, as if to exhaust all evil, and to contemplate the most complete apostasy from God, who knows all things, and gives signs and hints towards existence. It seems that in some way, the human nature, which has been utterly insulted, is suffering excessively. For the God of all things honored humanity with self-sufficiency. He did not create humans with just a word, like the other creations, but took dust from the earth and made humans, according to the words of the all-wise Moses. Humans were made in the image and likeness of God, and became a kind of ruler over the things on earth. Humans were also honored with the spirit of life, for God breathed the breath of life into their face. Therefore, the scripture says that humans, being in honor, did not understand, for they worshiped carved idols, and, as the prophetic word said, they bowed down to what their fingers had made.
pass_b_english: Our God, who loves us, is grieved by the insatiable greed that characterizes humanity, much like horses being restrained, and those who are snared by the nooses of love of glory.

The land is filled with the presence of horses, indicating that the disease of pride has spread throughout the land, affecting not just a few individuals, but rather, as if the whole land is occupied by this passion, and evil pervades everything.

God rebukes those who have stumbled against the law and disobeyed Him, having deliberately disobeyed God, who has spoken clearly, saying, 'If you enter the land that the Lord your God gives you as an inheritance, and you inherit it and live in it, and you say, "I will set up a ruler over myself, just like the other nations around me," then you shall set up as ruler over yourself one whom the Lord your God chooses' (Deuteronomy 17:14-15).

Furthermore, God also says about the one being set up, 'He will not multiply horses for himself, nor will he turn the people back to Egypt, so that he may not multiply horses for himself; and he will not greatly multiply silver and gold for himself' (Deuteronomy 17:16-17).

As a result, God blames humanity for making a collection of wealth and multiplying horses for themselves without limit, which is a transgression of His commandment, for He is the Lord your God, who has given them the land as an inheritance.

This reproach, as is likely, touches most of all those who have been allotted to lead, for they are the ones who should be setting an example, yet they are the ones who are disobeying God's commandment, which they were supposed to follow and uphold before others, and to rebuke those who transgress, as they were the ones who were supposed to be followed and seen as having been honored before others.
The land was filled with the abominations of the works of their hands, and they worshiped what their fingers had made.
And a man bowed down, and a human was humbled, and God will not lift them up.
God again accuses humanity of spiritual adultery, and the fact that many chose to worship false gods.

He declares that humanity has reached the limit of impiety, as if to exhaust all evil, and to contemplate the most complete apostasy from God, who knows all things, and gives signs and hints towards existence.
It seems that in some way, human nature, which has been utterly insulted, is suffering excessively.

For the God of all things honored humanity with self-sufficiency, creating humans not just with a word, like other creations, but by taking dust from the earth and making humans, according to the words of the all-wise Moses.
Humans were made in the image and likeness of God, and became a kind of ruler over the things on earth.
Humans were also honored with the spirit of life, for God breathed the breath of life into their face.

Therefore, the scripture says that humans, being in honor, did not understand, for they worshiped carved idols, and, as the prophetic word said, they bowed down to what their fingers had made (Psalm 49:20).
The scripture also says, 'Man, who is in honor, does not understand' (Psalm 49:20).
Despite this, humanity has chosen to disobey God's commandment, and has instead accumulated wealth and multiplied horses for themselves without limit.
As a result, God will not lift them up, and they will remain in their state of humiliation and bondage to their own desires.
